Dialogue_Text:
This weapon was once a favorite weapon of a drow priestess. She was a cruel matron, known for her hatred of men—even for drow standards. She liked to torture them, and make it all a spectacle for other men to observe. They say it was her way to emasculate not just one man, but all of them, all at once.
